caption:
Toto picked up the skipping rope for summer fitness, and the calves and shins felt it the next day.

Every jump asks your calves, Achilles and shins to absorb and push off. Sore legs usually mean too much, too soon, rather than skipping being bad for you.

Hybi's plan: 30 seconds on, 30 off for five to ten minutes. Keep jumps low and soft, clearing the rope by a couple of centimetres. Choose a mat or wooden floor over concrete, and add slow calf raises twice a week.

Pain in one spot on the shin, pain at rest or at night, or a swollen Achilles is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help you build up. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
